metadata.title: Integration Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating system-to-system integration channels that are attributable, intentional, and governable.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Asynchronous messaging substrates including events, queues, and buses that connect producer and consumer systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern establishing baseline trust assumptions for machine-to-machine, message-driven integration.

metadata.remarks: Integration Core defines the foundational trust properties required for system-generated messages to be treated as authoritative. This pattern establishes machine identity, ownership, lifecycle, and accountability for integration channels, without addressing transport semantics, schemas, or message security.

components.title: Integration Identity and Attribution
components.description: Binds integration messages to accountable producer and consumer system identities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid service or application accounts to emit unauthorized messages.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading as a trusted producer system.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding for non-human actors.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integration endpoints and producers are authenticated.
Identity attributes support correct attribution of integration activity.

components.title: Integration Ownership and Lifecycle
components.description: Defines ownership, purpose, and lifecycle for integration channels.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through abandoned or undocumented integration channels.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management to reduce residual and orphaned integration risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define ownership, purpose, and lifecycle of integration channels.
Unnecessary or obsolete integrations are disabled.

components.title: Integration Boundary and Scope Control
components.description: Enforces explicit trust relationships and access control for integration participation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships between integrated systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Systems participating in integrations are explicitly authorized.
Enforcement mechanisms prevent unauthorized integration access.

components.title: Integration Observability and Accountability
components.description: Provides traceability of integration activity for governance and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to integration misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging for accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integration events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports oversight and investigation of integration activity.
